diagnosis: Strong H1 revenue/profit/cash metrics predated the procurement event and therefore demonstrated company quality, not incremental upside caused by the new event.
The event reallocated volume but also sharply compressed unit prices; share gain and profit-pool expansion are not equivalent.
The underwriting memo did not quantify incremental post-bid product profit contribution under the new prices.
Low leverage and strong liquidity can create a relative competitive advantage while the sector's total profit/valuation pool still contracts.
The underwriting case identified financing resilience but did not establish a near-term incremental earnings, FCF, market-share or capital-return bridge attributable to the policy.
A relative winner is not automatically an absolute benchmark-beating opportunity.

genericHypothesesForFutureValidation.name: event_incremental_earnings_bridge
genericHypothesesForFutureValidation.question: What changes in forward revenue, unit economics, margin, utilization, cash flow or capital intensity because of this event versus the frozen pre-event baseline?
genericHypothesesForFutureValidation.antiOverfit: Do not require a fixed earnings threshold learned from these two cases.

genericHypothesesForFutureValidation.name: profit_pool_state
genericHypothesesForFutureValidation.question: Is the affected profit pool expanding, stable, shrinking, or merely being redistributed among competitors?
genericHypothesesForFutureValidation.antiOverfit: Share gain inside a shrinking pool may still be attractive, but requires explicit absolute profit math.

genericHypothesesForFutureValidation.name: absolute_vs_relative_catalyst
genericHypothesesForFutureValidation.question: Does the event create an absolute earnings/FCF/valuation catalyst for the selected company, or only make it safer/better than weaker peers?
genericHypothesesForFutureValidation.antiOverfit: Relative-only cases should not be automatically rejected; test whether another expression captures the same event with an absolute bridge.

promotionPolicy: None of these hypotheses changes V1.9 or v3.1 yet. Freeze and test them unchanged on a different historical year or forward sample before adoption.
discoveryConclusion: The failures do not invalidate hub-first discovery. They separate discovery recall from underwriting conversion quality.
